n, generates cases against them, and persists them: the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate,

t into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the c…\n- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Po
ll this after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the s
uite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's d
rafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and co
mes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n
- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite.
Past runs that executed it are not affected.\n- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-ev
al-case.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than mer
ging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.\n- [Upload
a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an in
gested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then reference. This is
what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEAT
URE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending
its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…\n- [Discover au
thenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-cap
abilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project au
thorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK rep
orting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Ingest a
completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The
whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n-
[Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-ho
sted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization'
s credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a mod
el lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `ru
nId` in the addressed project, immediately: the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also expire on their o
wn, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.\n- [Close an ope
n ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run complete and compu
tes its rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.\n- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `ru
ns/start`.\n- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-e
val-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-
login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are in
tent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that rep
orts as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.\n- [Get a run's gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/eval-runs/get-a-runs-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force over this run, or `null`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, n
ot only to those who can grant one: a waiver its readers cannot see is not a visible waiver.\n- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's release gate until an expiry you name. This does N
OT make the run pass: the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited record, and every surface that honors it, such
as the CLI's `eval gate`, reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and until when.\n- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting the gate back. Requires the manage tier.\n- [Pre

ead the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…\n- [Get the host-compat catalog](https://
